name: ctx-relay
description: A band above the prompt with context size, per-turn cost and the prompt-cache countdown. Past the handoff line it counts down 60 s, writes a handoff file with a fork, runs /clear and resumes in the new conversation; a new conversation lists unclaimed handoff files, press 1 to resume.

handoffTokens.title: Handoff line (tokens)
handoffTokens.description: Hand off automatically when the context reaches this many tokens. 0 = auto: 85% of Claude Code's auto-compact point. A value above the auto value uses the auto value.

handoffFormat.title: Handoff file format
handoffFormat.description: lite: four sections (Goal, Files, Verified, Next) with English headings; the content follows the conversation's language. full: the author's own eight-section Chinese format (hard constraints, coordination contract, progress INDEX); most users want lite.
